page.overview:
Who is Belisimo Topolino?

Belisimo Topolino was a usurer in Miragliano and commissioned an expedition by Emelio Cornelius to the Southlands, which competed with an expedition to El Cadavo.

Considering that Belisimo Topolino had a quarrel with El Cadavo is possible to estimate that he has lived around the 20th century.

Belisimo Topolino means "Beautiful little mouse" in Italian.

His name was changed in the Italian version of Warhammer Armies: Dogs of War (5th Edition) with Michelfinello Tascachiusa.
